versions.changelog:
Initial release of voice-agent-memory: a full-stack voice agent with persistent, cross-call memory.

- Make and receive phone calls with automatic, real-time transcription and memory storage.
- Vector-based memory per caller: agent recalls previous conversations on every call.
- Integrates Twilio (phone), ElevenLabs/Deepgram (voice), BlueColumn (memory), and Claude (agent logic).
- Auto-transcribes, summarizes, and stores every call with seamless recall on subsequent calls from the same number.
- Provides a FastAPI-based bridge server for handling real-time communication between components.
